name: agent-office
description: Plataforma local para orquestrar agentes Claude em pipelines, com escritório 3D em tempo real

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w shared && npm run assets
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
